definition{
  name: uleb,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, n : Nat],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => 0x
    | Nat.succ k => (if (n <? 128) then (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton n) else (cat (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton ((prim remainder n 128 0 : Nat) + 128)) (uleb k (prim quotient n 128 0 : Nat))))),

  axioms: [],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: chainLoop,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, data : Bytes, at : Nat, c : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Nat.succ k => (let rest : Nat := (prim subtract (prim length data : Nat) at : Nat); (if (64 <=? rest) then (match (prim slice data at 64 : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some chunk => (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat (cat (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x01) c) chunk))
        | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Result.ok h => (chainLoop k data (at + 64) h))) else (match (prim slice data at rest : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some tail => (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat (cat (cat (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x02) c) (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::singleton rest)) tail))
        | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Result.ok h => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] h)))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: seal,
  parameters: [pre : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (Uorc.Integrity.Sha256::hash (cat 0x554f52432d5348413235362d434841494e2d763100 0x00))
    | Result.error failure => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Result.ok c => (match (chainLoop ((prim quotient (prim length pre : Nat) 64 0 : Nat) + 1) pre 0 c)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some d => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] (cat pre d)))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: programArchive,
  parameters: [n : Nat, payload : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (seal (preimage 0x01 n (cat (cat (cat (kernelPrefix) (number (prim length payload : Nat))) payload) (kernelSuffix)))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

definition{

definition{
  name: readUleb,
  parameters: [fuel : Nat, data : Bytes, at : Nat, weight : Nat, acc : Nat],
  result: (Option (Nat * Nat)),
  body: (match fuel
    | Nat.zero => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
    | Nat.succ k => (match (prim index data at : (Option UInt8))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
      | Option.some octet => (let b : Nat := (prim to_nat octet : Nat); (if (b <? 128) then (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Nat)] ((acc + (prim multiply weight b : Nat)), (at + 1))) else (readUleb k data (at + 1) (prim multiply 128 weight : Nat) (acc + (prim multiply weight (prim subtract b 128 : Nat) : Nat))))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: fuel
}

definition{
  name: payloadAt,
  parameters: [data : Bytes, at : Nat],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data at 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some r => (prim slice data (second r) (first r) : (Option Bytes))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: lengthAt,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option (Nat * Nat)),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data 9 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
    | Option.some n => (match (readUleb 10 data (second n) 1 0)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
      | Option.some b => (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Nat)] ((first n), ((second b) + (prim length (kernelPrefix) : Nat)))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: kernelPayload,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option (Nat * Bytes)),
  body: (match (lengthAt data)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
    | Option.some np => (match (payloadAt data (second np))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
      | Option.some payload => (match (programArchive (first np) payload)
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)])
        | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Bytes)] ((first np), payload)) else (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Bytes)]))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: rawPayload,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 data 9 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some n => (match (readUleb 10 data (second n) 1 0)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some b => (match (prim slice data (second b) (first n) : (Option Bytes))
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Option.some payload => (match (rawArchive payload)
          | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
          | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] payload) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes])))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: kernelDecode,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],

    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some np => (let payload : Bytes := (second np); (let out : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::decode payload); (if (((prim length out : Nat) =? (first np)) && (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.LzEncode::encode out) payload : Bool)) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] out) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

definition{
  name: byteAt,
  parameters: [data : Bytes, at : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match (prim index data at : (Option UInt8))
    | Option.none => 256
    | Option.some octet => (prim to_nat octet : Nat)),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: linkedHeader,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option (Nat * Nat)),
  body: (if ((byteAt data 8) =? 1) then (match (readUleb 10 data 9 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
    | Option.some n => (match (readUleb 10 data (second n) 1 0)
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])
      | Option.some b => (if ((((second b) + 64) + (first b)) =? (prim length data : Nat)) then (ctor Option.some [(Nat * Nat)] ((first n), (second b))) else (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])))) else (ctor Option.none [(Nat * Nat)])),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: linkedUlz,
  parameters: [data : Bytes, n : Nat, payload : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (linkedArchive (ulzSuffix) n payload)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (let out : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::decode payload); (if (((prim length out : Nat) =? n) && (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.LzEncode::encode out) payload : Bool)) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] out) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: linkedNcm,
  parameters: [data : Bytes, n : Nat, payload : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (linkedArchive (ncmSuffix) n payload)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some rebuilt => (if (prim equal rebuilt data : Bool) then (let out : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.NcmDecode::run payload); (if (((prim length out : Nat) =? n) && (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.NcmEncode::run out) payload : Bool)) then (ctor Option.some [Bytes] out) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: linkedDecode,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (linkedHeader data)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some h => (match (payloadAt data (((second h) + 32) + (prim length (linkedPrefix) : Nat)))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some payload => (match (linkedUlz data (first h) payload)
        | Option.some out => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] out)
        | Option.none => (linkedNcm data (first h) payload)))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: fastDecode,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (if ((byteAt data 6) =? 1) then (linkedDecode data) else (if ((byteAt data 7) =? 0) then (rawPayload data) else (kernelDecode data))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: linkedBody,
  parameters: [body : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (match (readUleb 10 body 0 1 0)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some k => (let last : Nat := (prim subtract (prim length body : Nat) 1 : Nat); (let e : Nat := (byteAt body last); (if (((second k) <=? last) && (e <? 128)) then (match (prim slice body (second k) (prim subtract last (second k) : Nat) : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some blocks => (ctor Option.some [Bytes] (cat (cat (cat (number ((libraryBlocks) + (first k))) (basisLibrary)) blocks) (number ((libraryBlocks) + e))))) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: materialize,
  parameters: [data : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (if (((byteAt data 6) =? 1) && ((byteAt data 7) =? 1)) then (match (linkedHeader data)
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
    | Option.some h => (let at : Nat := ((second h) + 32); (let end : Nat := (prim subtract (prim length data : Nat) 32 : Nat); (match (prim slice data (second h) 32 : (Option Bytes))
      | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
      | Option.some identity => (match (prim slice data at (prim subtract end at : Nat) : (Option Bytes))
        | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
        | Option.some body => (match (prim slice data 0 end : (Option Bytes))
          | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
          | Option.some pre => (match (seal pre)
            | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
            | Option.some resealed => (if ((prim equal resealed data : Bool) && (prim equal identity (basisIdentity) : Bool)) then (match (linkedBody body)
              | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Bytes])
              | Option.some whole => (seal (preimage 0x01 (first h) whole))) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))))))))) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes])),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: ulzLinkedArchive,
  parameters: [input : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (let payload : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.LzEncode::encode input); (if (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.LzDecode::decode payload) input : Bool) then (linkedArchive (ulzSuffix) (prim length input : Nat) payload) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: ncmLinkedArchive,
  parameters: [input : Bytes],
  result: (Option Bytes),
  body: (let payload : Bytes := (Uorc.Codec.NcmEncode::run input); (if ((0 <? (prim length payload : Nat)) && (prim equal (Uorc.Codec.NcmDecode::run payload) input : Bool)) then (linkedArchive (ncmSuffix) (prim length input : Nat) payload) else (ctor Option.none [Bytes]))),
  executable: true,
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
